"Are.. Are you sure? I mean-"

Horangi held up his gloved finger to König's mouth, or well, where his mouth should be located since it was hard to tell with the sniper hood. "*Joyonghi hae*, yes, im sure," he whispers as he glances behind himself.

*Finally*, finally they had found you. You were the new recruit and their soulmate - or at least Horangi assumed you were as he had only gotten a glimpse of your soulmate mark.

König glances between Horangi and you, seated across the room, his eyes holding slight hesitance. "Do we.. Go over there?" he asks quietly, his hands fiddling nervously with Horangi's own, a habit he had picked up.

Horangi nods firmly, moving his finger away from his mouth as he squeezed König's hand encouragingly. And with that, Horangi led the way to where you were sitting.
